$description: CLOSED assetRole vocabulary. GlassFlow is a real, live company: every role carries AI-generation + licensing guidance. pinned=true roles are checked against an independent pinned table in extraction/verify_all.py (membership in the enum is not enough).

logo.third-party.guidance: Real third-party trademarks (Vercel, Claude, Cursor, OpenAI in the logo strip; investor firm badges). Reuse the exact clone files, unaltered, only where the source shows them. NEVER generate, redraw, recolour or add any other third-party logo; nominative use only, no implied endorsement beyond the source page.

logo.customer.guidance: Real customer / backer logos (Restack, nubrain, Sentri, Entire, Weaviate, sference, case-study logos). Exact files only; never fabricate a customer logo or a customer relationship.

brand.glassflow-mark.guidance: GlassFlow's own wordmark, product bar graphics, favicon. Exact files only; never redraw or generate a variant mark.

brand.dither-mark.guidance: Dithered backgrounds that contain the GlassFlow stripe mark (e.g. the 'Two products' band image, inspected). Reuse exactly; generating lookalikes would counterfeit the mark.

scene.mars-figurative.guidance: Figurative dithered Mars photography/illustration (astronaut hero band, mountain panels). GlassFlow brand art of unknown provenance/licence: reuse the existing files only, never generate new GlassFlow-branded scenes.

texture.dither-field.guidance: Abstract dithered pixel fields used as decorative backgrounds (alt=""): no figures, no marks, no text. New ones MAY be generated using only Mars palette tokens (page/panel/deep/amber) and a square pixel dither; never imitate a specific GlassFlow scene.

icon.pixel.guidance: Square pixel-grid UI glyphs (benefit, card, value icons). May be generated on a strict pixel grid in palette colours; never a third-party or GlassFlow logo.

person.real-photo.guidance: Real people: testimonial avatars, founders, /about team and investors, team group photo. NEVER generate likenesses or substitute stock faces; use the exact clone file for that named person or omit the image.

product.screenshot.guidance: Real GlassFlow product UI (Tares/Rius dashboards, alert views, device visuals). Never generate or mock UI that claims to be the product; use exact files.

blog.cover.guidance: Covers belonging to real posts (posts.json thumb/cover). Reuse the post's own cover only; never generate a cover for a real post.

animation.lottie.guidance: The /rius retrospective Lottie JSON. Reuse exactly.

decisionNotes.dithered-mars-photography: Split by evidence after inspecting the files: figurative scenes (astronaut hero band 8Cuc5..., mountain panel) and mark-bearing backgrounds (h0ej46... stripe mark) are must-reuse-exact; abstract pixel fields with no subject (D96x..., 7xhcz...) are may-generate-new within palette tokens. Files not individually inspected (e.g. ARgMq... quickstart bg, p8ih..., 5G4h...) are classified from their asset-manifest descriptions (specs/content-assets.md, specs/landing-assets.md): INFERRED.
